name: Pearl-Throne Approach
introDiscord:
For the first time, the palace itself becomes visible.

A vast pearl-covered gate rises above the kingdom while ceremonial roads
converge beneath it.
introTwitch:
For the first time, the palace itself becomes visible.

A vast pearl-covered gate rises above the kingdom while ceremonial roads
converge beneath it.

pearl-throne-approach-approach.prompt: Pearl-Throne Approach opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A Pearl-Throne Sentinel guards the palace road.

right.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's sign:

'PALACE FOUND!!!

Only took—

Glimmer says not to record how long.'

forward.message: A ceremonial gatehouse coffer contains Star Candies.

pearl-throne-approach-depths.prompt: Deeper within Pearl-Throne Approach, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A royal visitor fountain restores strength.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Sentinel blocks the inner approach.

forward.message: A pearl-lined chest contains Star Candies.

pearl-throne-approach-threshold.prompt: Near Pearlescent Gate, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A palace guest offering box contains Star Candies.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Palace preparation potion.

Same potion.

Fancier location.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Pearl-Throne Sentinel guards Pearlescent Gate.

boss-antechamber.name: Pearlescent Gate
boss-antechamber.prompt: The enormous palace gate begins opening.

bossPromptDiscord:
The enormous palace gate begins opening.

A mother-of-pearl figure steps between its doors.

Use /yes to enter the royal palace grounds or /no to remain
a perfectly respectable trespasser outside.

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Pearlescent Gate. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The Warden yields.

The palace grounds open.

Shizuki's next message:

'WE ARE INSIDE THE CASTLE.

ACT NATURAL.'
